subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased and consolidated into existing availability/depth-aware sub-agent guidance, changed into a coordinated no-nested-spawn policy, or closed manually as already covered by current guidance?
rationale: The branch is technically small, but it changes maintainer-owned prompt policy where current main already has overlapping guidance and supports configured nested spawning; the protected maintainer signal prevents cleanup closure by automation.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, Sub-Agent Delegation, child-prompt, Codex, or tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, Codex/OpenClaw prompt surfaces, and tool descriptions together.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat current main guidance as sufficient and close this stale branch manually without merging duplicate prompt text.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing Tooling, Messaging, Sub-Agent Delegation, child-prompt, Codex, or tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this maintainer-labeled prompt-policy proposal and already made the product-direction call against the related tool-policy approach.
